children.text: Abyssal demons offer high experience rates while being completely afk. Being that they don't deal much damage, they're a great option for lower level players.
⬥ Abyssal Demons drop the Abyssal whip
which are required for the Slayer Log. They also drop alchables and hard clues at a decent rate.
⬥ If killed in the Wilderness, they can also drop
which can be helpful for Ultimate Slayer hunters.
Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.

• Allows for an easy teleport to the lvl 18 wilderness obelisk.
⬥

• 14% damage reduction and 9% damage increase whilst in the Wilderness.
        ⬩ This effect scales with the tier of your puzzle box.
    • Tier 6 allows you to put it in your tool belt.
⬥
Location and How to Get there
The best spot for abyssal demons is located at the level 18 Wilderness obelisk (Graveyard of Shadows). The fastest way to reach the location is using the portable obelisk or an obelisk shard.
on yellow tile as shown below (2E of stump NE of obelisk) and stand on red tile (2N and 2W of stump SE of obelisk).
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If your character gets walked off the marked tile, step back on it, and click the nearest demon.
